verdict.rationale: Supermemory offers a full REST API with official TypeScript/Python SDKs, a self-hosted single-binary deployment option, and a CLI (`npx supermemory setup`), all of which support headless/CI-style automation without a GUI. However, there is no explicit CI/CD example, no documented non-interactive auth flow for CI environments (OAuth-centric per supermemory-comm-2), and no CI pipeline or automation-testing docs. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage examples, non-interactive/service-account auth documentation for automation, and independent evidence of running successfully in a CI pipeline.
